scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && cp dist/index.html dist/404.html
scripts.testes: npm run build && uv run pytest -v --html relatorio/relatorio.html --self-contained-html
scripts.testes:visual: npm run build && uv run pytest -v --painel --slowmo 300 --html relatorio/relatorio.html --self-contained-html
scripts.testes:navegadores: npm run build && uv run pytest -v --browser chromium --browser firefox --browser webkit --html relatorio/relatorio.html --self-contained-html
